item.title: There drains are making a loud clanking noise every time a car drives over them, 1st November
item.description:
There are 2 drains, a smaller one on the corner of Pirton Road and Cheltenham road east, minor noise. And one just beside the pedestrian lights outside Pirton Corner Garage on the Gloucester bound side, this one is aggressive, its a 2 part triangular cover which has clearly dislodged and is clanking together. These drains were repaired last year but clearly not fit for purpose. There are problems all along the Cheltenham Road East when the cycle path was implemented. Locally residents shouldnt have to put up with these continual and repeated noise issues as a result of poor quality drain covers and poor installation.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Cheltenham Road East, Churchdown, Tewkesbury

item.title: Green Cycle path now repaired in Black!, 1st November
item.description:
Residents who have raised concerns about the street lighting work between Bishop’s Cleeve Sports Pavilion and Newlands, opposite GE Aviation. I was previously advised that the electricity supply issue had been resolved, but I understand the lights were still not operating on Friday morning 30th Nov 26, with cyclists using the route at around 6.30am in darkness. Hence why I am seeking an update on when the lighting will be fully restored. I am also querying why two sections of the cycle path have been resurfaced in black tarmac rather than reinstated with the existing green surface, as I understand repairs should normally be carried out on a like-for-like basis. Thank you to everyone who continues to report issues and keep me informed.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): A435, Bishop's Cleeve, Tewkesbury
Report on FixMyStreet
